Corpora.Name: architecture
Corpora.Description: Search a curated corpus of software architecture books (Software Architecture - The Hard Parts, Microservices Patterns by Chris Richardson, Building Microservices 2nd ed by Sam Newman, DDD Distilled and Implementing DDD by Vaughn Vernon, Domain-Driven Design by Eric Evans (the Blue Book), Learning Domain-Driven Design by Vlad Khononov, Software Architecture Patterns, Building Evolutionary Architectures, Building Event-Driven Microservices, Building an Event-Driven Data Mesh, Practical Event-Driven Microservices Architecture, Monolith to Microservices, Enabling Microservice Success) for established architecture concepts, patterns, trade-offs, DDD terminology (bounded contexts, aggregates, ubiquitous language, context mapping), microservices design and decomposition, evolutionary architecture and fitness functions, event-driven patterns, and team/org aspects of microservices adoption. Prefer over WebSearch for any established architectural concept. Use WebSearch for recent developments, specific products, or news.
Books: microservices\Building Microservices Designing Fine-Grained Systems 2nd By Sam Newman.pdf
Implementing Domain Driven Design - Vaughn Vernon.pdf
domain driven design\Domain-Driven Design - Tackling Complexity in the Heart of Software - Eric Evans - 2003.pdf

Corpora.Name: system-design
Corpora.Description: Search a curated corpus of system design books (System Design - ByteByteGo, System Design Interview by Alex Xu, Designing Data-Intensive Applications by Martin Kleppmann) for scalable system design questions: sharding and partitioning, replication and consistency models, queueing and stream processing, caching, load balancing, consistent hashing, leader election, capacity estimation, transactions and isolation levels, and worked design examples (URL shortener, chat system, news feed, etc.). Prefer over WebSearch for system-design-interview-style questions and scalability fundamentals. Use ArchitectureCorpus for higher-level architectural patterns and DDD; use WebSearch for recent products and news.
Books: Designing Data Intensive Applications by Martin Kleppmann 2017.pdf

Corpora.Name: ai-engineering
Corpora.Description: Search a corpus of AI Engineering content (AI Engineering by Chip Huyen) for production AI/ML system topics: prompt engineering, RAG system design, LLM evaluation, embeddings, fine-tuning vs prompting trade-offs, hallucination mitigation, inference cost & latency optimisation, guardrails and safety, data flywheels, and end-to-end AI product design. Prefer over WebSearch for established AI-engineering concepts and patterns. Use WebSearch for very recent model releases or specific products.

Corpora.Name: testing
Corpora.Description: Search a corpus of software testing content (Unit Testing Principles, Practices, and Patterns by Vladimir Khorikov) for: test pyramid and boundaries, test doubles (mocks/stubs/spies/fakes), London vs Detroit/Chicago school of TDD, what makes a test valuable (4-pillar framework: protection against regressions, resistance to refactoring, fast feedback, maintainability), designing for testability, test smells, mutation testing, property-based testing, integration vs unit test strategy. Prefer over WebSearch for testing concepts. Use WebSearch for specific framework versions or tools.
Books: Unit Testing Principles, Practices, and Patterns - Vladimir Khorikov.pdf

Corpora.Name: code-craft
Corpora.Description: Search a corpus of code-quality and functional-programming content (Good Code - Bad Code, Functional Programming in C# 2nd ed.) for: module and API design at code level, encapsulation, abstraction, error handling (exceptions vs results vs monads), naming and code clarity, defensive vs declarative programming, immutability, pure functions, higher-order functions, pattern matching, composition over inheritance, code smells. Prefer over WebSearch for code-craft concepts. Use WebSearch for language-specific framework guidance.
Books: Functional Programming in Csharp - 2nd Edition - Manning.pdf
